stages.name: Primordial Cell
stages.description: A single microscopic cell drifting in a warm primordial sea.

stages.name: Replicating Cell
stages.description: The cell learns to copy itself. Division becomes your first engine of growth.

stages.name: Multicellular Organism
stages.description: Cells cooperate, specialise and share the work of staying alive.

stages.name: Early Aquatic Life
stages.description: Complex soft-bodied life spreads through the shallow oceans.

stages.name: Primitive Fish
stages.description: A backbone forms. Era bonus: +10% all production.

stages.name: Early Amphibian
stages.description: Fins become limbs as life pulls itself onto the shore.

stages.name: Primitive Reptile
stages.description: Scaled skin and shelled eggs free life from the water's edge.

stages.name: Early Mammal
stages.description: Warm blood, fur and careful parenting emerge.

stages.name: Early Primate
stages.description: Grasping hands and forward-facing eyes. Era bonus: +10% all production.

stages.name: Early Hominin
stages.description: Walking upright frees the hands for something new.

stages.name: Homo erectus
stages.description: Fire, travel and shaped stone tools mark a major milestone.

stages.name: Homo sapiens
stages.description: Language, art and culture accelerate everything.

stages.name: Enhanced Human
stages.description: Biology becomes editable. Era bonus: +10% all production.

stages.name: Cybernetic Human
stages.description: Flesh and machine merge into a single nervous system.

stages.name: Digital Consciousness
stages.description: The mind is mapped, copied and run on silicon.

stages.name: Disembodied Intelligence
stages.description: Thought no longer needs a body to exist.

stages.name: Energy Form
stages.description: Consciousness rides on pure energy. Era bonus: +10% all production.

stages.name: Stellar Consciousness
stages.description: Awareness stretches across a star system.

stages.name: Cosmic Entity
stages.description: An intelligence operating at the scale of galaxies.

stages.name: Pure Energy
stages.description: The journey is complete: a luminous sphere of conscious energy.

upgrades.name: Bio-Replicator
upgrades.description: A simple self-copying molecule that harvests EP on its own.

upgrades.name: Genetic Optimization
upgrades.description: Each click carries more evolutionary weight.

upgrades.name: Advanced Replicator
upgrades.description: Faster, error-correcting replication machinery.

upgrades.name: Neural Automator
upgrades.description: Primitive signalling cells coordinate production.

upgrades.name: Evolution Multiplier
upgrades.description: Boosts all EP production, manual and automatic.

upgrades.name: Tidal Spawner
upgrades.description: Spawning grounds that pulse with every tide.

upgrades.name: Instinct Reflex
upgrades.description: Hard-wired reflexes amplify every click.

upgrades.name: Adaptive Radiation
upgrades.description: Life diversifies into every niche. Boosts all production.

upgrades.name: Amniotic Incubator
upgrades.description: Protected eggs let generations grow anywhere on land.

upgrades.name: Tribal Foragers
upgrades.description: Bands of foragers gather EP across the savanna.

upgrades.name: Fire Mastery
upgrades.description: Cooked food fuels bigger brains and stronger clicks.

upgrades.name: Tool Workshop
upgrades.description: Shaped stone multiplies what each pair of hands can do.

upgrades.name: Spoken Language
upgrades.description: Ideas spread between minds. Boosts all production.

upgrades.name: Agricultural Revolution
upgrades.description: Settled farming feeds cities of innovators.

upgrades.name: Gene Forge
upgrades.description: Designer genomes compiled on demand.

upgrades.name: Neural Lace
upgrades.description: A direct brain interface turns intent into EP.

upgrades.name: Cyber Foundry
upgrades.description: Self-assembling factories of augmented bodies.

upgrades.name: Mind Upload Cluster
upgrades.description: Server farms running thousands of digital minds.

upgrades.name: Recursive Self-Improvement
upgrades.description: Intelligence that improves itself. Boosts all production.

upgrades.name: Plasma Harvester
upgrades.description: Draws EP straight from stellar plasma.

upgrades.name: Quantum Will
upgrades.description: Each act of will collapses reality in your favour.

upgrades.name: Dyson Lattice
upgrades.description: A web of collectors wrapped around a star.

upgrades.name: Cosmic Harmony
upgrades.description: All matter resonates with you. Doubles base production per level.

upgrades.name: Galactic Resonator
upgrades.description: Entire galaxies hum in a single productive chord.
